A [[human]] [[Gender|male]] '''security officer''' served in a [[Moff]] [[Gideon]]'s [[Gideon's Imperial remnant|remnant]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], operating at the command center at a [[Nevarro Imperial base|base]] on the [[planet]] [[Nevarro]]. Around [[9 ABY]], he noticed that the security feed for the [[Shuttle bay (Nevarro)|shuttle bay]] went down and attempted to contact the [[shuttle]] bay. However, the [[security officer]] was [[Second skirmish on Nevarro|ambushed]] by a group of infiltrators and choked to [[death]] by the [[Marshal]] [[Carasynthia Dune|Cara Dune]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Shuttle bay, the security feed just went down. Can you check your relay hub?|The security officer|<ref name="Chapter 12" />}}
[[File:NevarroSecurityOfficerKilled-TMCh12.png|thumb|left|300px|The officer was strangled by Cara Dune, who ambushed him from behind.]]
During the [[New Republic Era|reign]] of the [[New Republic]], the [[security officer]] served as part of a [[Gideon's Imperial remnant|remnant]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] which was led by the Imperial [[Moff]] [[Gideon]]. [[Gender|He]] operated at an [[Nevarro Imperial base|Imperial base]] on the [[Volcano|volcanic]] [[planet]] [[Nevarro]], stationed at the command center.<ref name="Chapter 12" /> In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> the security [[officer]] was at his post when the security feed from the base's [[Shuttle bay (Nevarro)|shuttle bay]] had gone down. He tried to contact the [[shuttle]] bay to resolve the situation, unbeknownst to the fact the personnel there had been [[Death|killed]] by a team of four infiltrators who were there to [[Second skirmish on Nevarro|destroy]] the base.<ref name="Chapter 12" />

Having had no response from the shuttle bay, the security officer continued to talk over the comms. However, he was interrupted when the four infiltrators arrived at the command center. One of them, the [[Marshal]] [[Carasynthia Dune|Cara Dune]], took the security officer in a choke hold, strangling the officer to death. As the [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin]] then deactivated all of the feeds on the security officer's console, the [[Magistrate]] [[Greef Karga]] took the officer's [[code cylinder]] and his [[Mythrol]] [[The Fledgling Mythrol|comrade]] took the officer's [[SE-14r light repeating blaster]]. The infiltrators left the command center shortly after and were eventually able to destroy the base.<ref name="Chapter 12" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Shuttle bay? Shuttle bay, this is…|The security officer continues to contact the shuttle bay|<ref name="Chapter 12" />}}
[[File:NevarroSecurityOfficerStation-TMCh12.png|thumb|right|300px|The officer worked from a console in the station command center.]]
The security officer was a [[human]] male with [[Color|light]] skin, black [[hair]], and brown [[eye]]s. After failing to get a response from the shuttle bay, he continued to reach out to the area until he was ambushed.<ref name="Chapter 12" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|This will come in handy.|Greef Karga takes the security officer's code cylinder|<ref name="Chapter 12" />}}
The security officer [[Clothing|wore]] the standard black [[Imperial officer's uniform|uniform]] of an Imperial officer, including an [[Imperial kepi]] and a [[code cylinder]] attached below his left shoulder. He carried an SE-14r light repeating blaster in a holster attached to his belt.<ref name="Chapter 12" />

==Behind the scenes==
The security officer appeared in "[[Chapter 12: The Siege]]" of [[Jon Favreau]]'s [[2019]] [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', directed by [[Carl Weathers]]<ref name="Chapter 12" /> and released on [[November 20]], [[2020]].<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-november-2020|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in November 2020}}</ref> Credited as "Imperial Security Officer," he was played by [[Morgan Benoit]].<ref name="Chapter 12" />
